title: Release B, part 5: a broken reader no longer wipes a site's facts, searches that find nothing become work, Closed made stricter, Gemini warns only on the unexpe
why: decisions/0163 §8's gap list (research/knowledge-engine-gap-review-2026-11-14.md): P6-1, P1-3, F2, F3, F4. Jason, 2026-11-15: finish Release B without waiting for his keys. Everything ships off; the master switch stays off. (1) Parser drift (P6-1): a read of a site that finds nothing on pages that had facts used to delete those facts; now they're kept (shown with 'last checked'), and after two such reads 'The engine needs a person' asks for a reader fix, naming the site and its pages. (2) A search that finds nothing (P1-3): recorded as demand for the place searched or the searcher's area, named or not; a kind of place becomes that kind's job in the town (from our own kinds, never the words), a topic waits as one of W6's gaps. (3) The public confirms Closed (F2): three answers on at least two days within 60 days, none saying open since. (4) Three states only (F3): the listing says 'Still open?' with the source's own words; 'Possibly closed' and 'Reported closed' are retired, and a Closed listing isn't scored down. (5) Gemini (F4): its daily allowance is paced to be used, so it warns only on the unexpected: background work at its stop before 18:00 UTC three days running, or the visitors' reserve under 5%. Database update: 2026-11-17_search_demand_empty (search demand's dest becomes short text if it's an ENUM; nothing else changes; safe to run twice). Tests: staging unit 49, identity 36, Gemini guards 21. Built on Sync 2026-11-15 20:11 UTC.
